blocks.text: I am opening this thread so our notes on the executive messaging work for {{fact:f:E-2023-001.client}} stay in one place as we get going. For your file and ours, the working contacts are set: Jennifer Herrera on your side, and on ours Amy Carter, who is drafting the core messages, with me carrying the engagement day to day.

We have made a start on the Suarez-Jones messaging. We are pulling together the list for the opening interviews, and Amy Carter is shaping the first set of executive messages from what we heard at the kickoff. You will hear from us on a steady cadence from here, and each note will be tied to the piece of work it concerns, so the thread stays easy to follow.

One thing would help before we get much further: your read on which audience comes first for the leadership story. If the investor view and the internal view pull in different directions, tell me now and we will build to it. A short call works if that is easier than writing it out, and I will set one up on your word.
